correctness.rationale: Exact matrix multiplication yields M^3-I=(S^s-I)C with determinant C=S^s a unit. Frobenius and commutation identify all 3·2^j fixed spaces with spatial-shift fixed spaces. Reduction modulo the unique nilpotent maximal ideal (S-I) proves M^t-I invertible whenever 3 does not divide t. The global order and every least period follow; subtracting nested finite-field fixed-space counts gives population and maximal fraction. Exhaustive independent simulation for 15 binary size/stride cases covers 525,348 configurations but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete, pointwise space-time synchronization law for a natural reversible two-memory cellular automaton is stronger than a global order bound: it determines every primitive temporal orbit and the exact proportion in maximal cycles across arbitrary dyadic length, stride and finite characteristic-two alphabet. The all-stride classification identifies a sharp gcd phase invariant, while distinct infinite-line entropy values may share finite-ring periodic spectra. It gives a mathematically motivated finite-size contrast to entropy computability, beyond a single ad hoc data table.
